mapper.select: select dws_cohort.id, #{dates} dates, q.register_dates, q.pkg, q.register_version, q.country, q.cohort_day, q.cohort_user_num, IFNULL(d_user.user_num, 0) register_user_num, IFNULL(ROUND(q.cohort_user_num / IFNULL(d_user.user_num, 0), 8), 0) conversion_rate, q.extra_type source_type from (select cohort_q.register_dates, cohort_q.pkg, cohort_q.register_version, cohort_q.country, cohort_q.cohort_day, cohort_q.extra_type, COUNT(DISTINCT duc.user_id) cohort_user_num FROM (SELECT du.`pkg`, du.register_version, du.`country`, du.`register_dates` register_dates, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, du.register_date, du.create_time) cohort_day, du.extra_type FROM dwd_user_conversion du WHERE du.dates = #{dates} GROUP BY du.`pkg`, du.`register_version`, du.`country`, du.`register_dates`, du.extra_type, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, du.register_date, du.create_time)) cohort_q left join dwd_user_conversion duc on (cohort_q.pkg = duc.pkg and cohort_q.`register_version` = duc.register_version and cohort_q.`country` = duc.country and cohort_q.`register_dates` = duc.register_dates and cohort_q.extra_type = duc.extra_type and cohort_q.cohort_day = TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, duc.register_date, duc.create_time)) GROUP BY cohort_q.pkg, cohort_q.`register_version`, cohort_q.`country`, cohort_q.`register_dates`, cohort_q.cohort_day, cohort_q.extra_type) q LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_cohort_conversion dws_cohort on (q.register_dates = dws_cohort.register_dates and q.register_version = dws_cohort.register_version and q.country = dws_cohort.country and q.pkg = dws_cohort.pkg and q.cohort_day = dws_cohort.cohort_day and q.extra_type = dws_cohort.source_type) LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_register d_user on (q.register_dates = d_user.dates and q.register_version = d_user.version and q.country = d_user.country and q.pkg = d_user.pkg)
